scale.label: 30 mm heroic (about 32.5 mm to the crown)
scale.note: 30 mm from the soles to the visor line (eye convention, ratio from miniature_scale_convert); heroic power-armour proportions: helm about 1/5.7 of the height, hands and weapon oversized, 7.6 mm thigh and 7.3 mm shin.

catalog.revision_note: resin figure, helm, backpack and 32 mm base
catalog.base: 32 mm round deck-plate base, 4 mm, 5 × 2 mm magnet pocket
catalog.description: A Vigilant of the Aster Compact advancing at low ready: Kestrel-pattern exosuit over a ribbed bodysuit, Lance bullpup rifle shouldered and angled down, torso bladed to the left foot. Helm and backpack are separate keyed parts, swappable across the whole line.
buildNotes: Sculpted as signed-distance fields (tools/sdfkit.py): smooth-blended anatomy, armour plates grown off the body and cut to oval outlines, panel lines engraved 0.25-0.4 mm deep.
Heroic scale: 30 mm to the visor line; the Lance rifle is about 13 mm long with a 0.84 mm barrel and 1.9 mm deep receiver, thickened well past true scale so it prints and survives handling.
The figure stands on an integral 1.1 mm footplate that drops into a keyed recess in the base (0.1 mm glue clearance per side); no thin pins through the feet.
Helm on a 1.6 mm D-flat peg (keyed to face along the rifle), backpack on a 2.0 mm D-flat peg: sizes from miniature_base_and_peg; every helm and pack in the line fits every figure.
Prints: figure tilted on supports at the angle miniature_support_plan picked, helm and backpack on supports, base flat on the plate (magnet pocket vented to the rim).
catalog.limitations: Procedural sculpt, not a hand sculpt: faces of the armour are smooth (no battle damage or texture), hands are gauntlet fists. Printability is a heuristic screen through unified-CAD-MCP, not a test print; the STEP is a faceted reference, not a parametric model.
